newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy recalls 1,252 cars in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy recalls 1,252 cars in Japan.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd said on Thursday it has told the Transport Ministry that it is recalling 1,252 Legacy cars due to a problem with a cruise control system.
The Legacy GT models equipped with the defective cruise control systems were made between September 2, 1993, and March 4, 1994, and were sold only in Japan.
The problem lies with the wires connecting the accelerator pedal to the cruise control system, which could lead to problems with the revolution of the engine.
Nissan Motor Co Ltd owns 4.2 percent of Fuji Heavy.
Fuji Heavy did not export the Legacy GT model, a Fuji spokesman said. It has no estimate of repair costs, but they are likely to be small, he said.
